# Łukasz Nitkowski — Senior Frontend Developer (Netfusion)

> Self-employed Senior Frontend Developer from Poland with 7 years of commercial experience. Builds accessible, high-performance web applications in React, TypeScript and Next.js for international clients across finance, e-commerce, energy, sport and education.

## Profile

- Core stack: React (incl. React Compiler), TypeScript, Next.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS / SCSS
- Also: React Native, Angular / AngularJS, Svelte, Vue / Nuxt, Node.js, Express.js
- State & data: Redux, Zustand, TanStack Query, REST, GraphQL
- Quality: unit testing (Vitest, Jest, Testing Library), code review, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), SEO, performance
- AI-assisted development: GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, local LLMs, building agents (code review, accessibility)
- Education: technical physics (energy conversion), Gdańsk University of Technology
- Languages: Polish, English

## Experience

- Oke Poland | Hypersolid — Senior Frontend Developer, international projects with a Dutch team (until 08.2026)
- Speednet — Frontend Developer (from 2022)
- PwC — Junior → Mid Frontend Developer (4+ years, until 2022)
- Energy companies — renewable-energy engineer (1 year)
